frontmatter.title: AI Engineering Fundamentals: What It Is, What It Isn't, and Why It's Not Just ML
frontmatter.subheading: A practical breakdown of AI engineering beyond hype, buzzwords, and academic machine learning
frontmatter.excerpt: AI engineering is not about training models from scratch. This article clarifies what AI engineering really is, what it is not, and how it differs from data science and traditional machine learning.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
